Objective: add an xUnit v3 guard test asserting that every HotshotLogistics assembly the test project references is compiled for .NET 10, and capture it FAILING against the current net8.0 build. The test names the assemblies it covers - HotshotLogistics.Core, HotshotLogistics.Api, HotshotLogistics.Application, HotshotLogistics.Contracts, HotshotLogistics.Domain, and HotshotLogistics.Data - the six projects the test project references. A project the test project does not reference (MigrationRunner, HotshotLogistics.DbSetup, and the sibling test projects) is covered by the Release build gate instead, so this test does not overstate what it proves. The GREEN flip (target frameworks) is a later task's scope - do not modify any project, config, or documentation file here.

- {worktree}/5-Test/tests/HotshotLogistics.Tests/Utils/Infrastructure/TargetFrameworkTests.cs - new public class TargetFrameworkTests, namespace HotshotLogistics.Tests.Utils.Infrastructure (match the neighbours such as ArchitectureTests.cs). Name each covered assembly - one test per named assembly or one test iterating the named assemblies, in this one file, each named per the test standard pattern MethodName_StateUnderTest_ExpectedBehavior.
